summary: Depression may change which emotional faces children notice most, but the pattern appears to depend on family history. Children at higher familial risk became increasingly focused on sad faces, while lower-risk children with rising symptoms paid less attention to happy ones.

title: Quantum teleportation breakthrough: Scientists crack a 25-year entanglement challenge

The technique could make complex entangled systems much easier to measure, opening new possibilities for quantum teleportation, communication, and computing.

title: This 245-million-year-old fossil still has its stomach and intestines

title: Brain scans reveal which disorders are linked to faster brain aging

The strongest effects appeared in Alzheimer’s and mild cognitive impairment, while ADHD and autism showed no significant overall difference.

title: The ice blasting from Saturn's moon Enceladus is stranger than scientists realized

The process could explain Cassini’s puzzling ice-grain chemistry while giving future spacecraft a powerful advantage in searching for organic compounds and clues to life.

title: This suitcase-sized spacecraft could hear the universe before stars existed

title: Scientists expected these Galápagos sea turtles to wander. They stayed put

title: Is the universe infinite? The answer gets weird fast
summary: Measurements of ancient light from the cosmic microwave background suggest that the universe is remarkably flat. Space could even be flat while wrapping around on itself in exotic ways.
